R4 added a source-shape ratchet: src/ is now held strictly to the literal appearing only in src/run/paths.mjs (1 occurrence), while test/ (188 occurrences/48 files) and evals/ (7/4) are pinned at their measured counts rather than migrated, per the stated non-goal.
